写作前置 · 文中表达

下面的表达来自阅读材料，例句按本题语境编写。选择确实需要的表达即可。

The World of Sugar｜全球贸易与误解纠正

threatening the livelihood of

威胁……的生计

适合用于描述资源衰退或不公平竞争怎样影响依赖某产业谋生的人。可以作为结果分词短语，但要让前面的原因具体可理解。

本题例句 · 编写示范

Overfishing can deplete local fish stocks, threatening the livelihood of small-scale fishing communities.

现有题目明确谈过度捕捞对数百万人生计的风险；表达可直接连接鱼类资源减少与沿海家庭收入受损。

回到这份材料的精读

Saving the saiga · 生存适应与早期数量变化

on an industrial scale

以极大的、工业化的规模

适合描述技术与设备使资源开采规模扩大；不能把所有小型经营都称为 industrial scale。

本题例句 · 编写示范

Large vessels can remove fish on an industrial scale, making effective limits on catches essential.

过度捕捞题讨论捕捞能力与生态压力，大型船舶造成的规模效应与原文大规模猎杀直接相关。

relieve the pressure on

减轻……所承受的压力

说明措施帮助哪个对象；on 后接鱼群、生态系统等，随后解释压力怎样减少。

本题例句 · 编写示范

Temporary closures can relieve the pressure on vulnerable fish stocks by allowing them time to reproduce.

直接用于过度捕捞的措施段，把休渔与鱼群恢复相连；不套用赛加保护倡议的历史结果。

回到这份材料的精读

Saving the saiga · 栖息地、疾病、气候与恢复

working in partnership with

与……共同合作

适合说明跨地区生态治理的合作关系，应明确谁和谁合作以及共同处理什么问题。

本题例句 · 编写示范

Coastal authorities, working in partnership with neighbouring countries, can coordinate limits on catches from shared fish stocks.

过度捕捞涉及跨界鱼群，原文跨境物种保护中的机构协作与共享海域监管高度吻合。

protect and restore

保护并修复

protect 强调避免进一步破坏，restore 强调恢复已经受损的状态；并列时应同时存在预防与修复需要。

本题例句 · 编写示范

Fishing restrictions should protect and restore marine ecosystems while allowing communities time to adapt.

可用于说明限制捕捞的生态目标，并与题目中的渔业生计相衔接。

回到这份材料的精读

Overfishing of the world’s oceans threatens many species with extinction and is putting the livelihood of millions of people around the world at risk. What are the causes of this problem and what can be done to prevent it from happening?

完整写作 · 过度捕捞：从激励与监管写到对策 →工作台尚未开始工作台保留一份独立首稿与修订；本页已有作答照常保留。

本次写作任务

写两个主体段，约180–220词。第一段写捕捞能力与逐利/监管，第二段分别提出限制和执行机制；同时照顾生态与依靠渔业的社区，不编造研究数字。

0 词

对照答案，回到证据

参考写法

下列段落为针对原题编写的参考写法，用于对照内容和表达；写作没有唯一标准答案。

Overfishing can result from the combination of powerful fishing methods and incentives to maximise the immediate catch. Large vessels and efficient equipment allow operators to remove substantial quantities of fish, while each business may fear losing income if competitors continue fishing. Where catch limits are weak or poorly enforced, individual firms have little reason to leave fish in the sea for future seasons. The problem is intensified when the same stocks move across national boundaries, because restrictions in one area may be undermined by heavy fishing elsewhere.

Effective action therefore requires both enforceable limits and cooperation between the authorities responsible for shared waters. Catch quotas and temporary closures can reduce pressure on vulnerable stocks, but they need monitoring and credible penalties; a rule that is routinely ignored changes little. Governments should also support fishing communities during restrictions, for example through assistance in moving towards less damaging practices or alternative sources of income. Without that support, measures designed to protect future livelihoods may face resistance from people struggling to survive now. The aim should be to make sustainable fishing a practical long-term choice, rather than simply announce a ban.

原因段没有堆抽象名词：设备提高捕捞能力，竞争激励促使当下多捕，跨界鱼群削弱单方限制。

措施段逐项承接：限额/休渔对应压力，监测/处罚对应执行，跨区域协作对应跨界问题。

livelihood题干范围被保留：过渡支持说明保护鱼群与渔民短期收入怎样协调。

答后精读

篇章结构

能力—激励—执行薄弱—跨界扩大。

限制—执行—协作—社区过渡支持。

词语与搭配

credible penalties：能落实的惩罚，避免只有法规名称。

shared waters：衔接跨界鱼群。

a practical long-term choice：让结论落在可执行性。

句子精读

... because restrictions in one area may be undermined by heavy fishing elsewhere → because解释国际协调的必要。

Without that support, ... may face resistance ... → 解释社区支持为何不是无关福利。

儿童肥胖：原因—措施对应而非空泛建议未作答原因与措施 · 原题拆段写作 · 参考段落与逐段讲解

写作前置 · 文中表达

下面的表达来自阅读材料，例句按本题语境编写。选择确实需要的表达即可。

The World of Sugar｜工业化、消费与作者立场

attempts to reduce consumption

降低消费量的努力

在健康话题里要补清consumption指什么，例如含糖饮料，而不是笼统主张减少所有食品消费。适合描述措施与商业激励之间的关系。

本题例句 · 编写示范

Attempts to reduce consumption of sugary drinks among children are more likely to succeed when healthier alternatives are affordable and easy to obtain.

儿童肥胖题要求提出措施；这句话把减少含糖饮料摄入与可负担替代品联系起来，强调环境支持而非只责怪个人自控。

a large number of processed foods

大量加工食品

可讨论配方、标签或食品环境，但加工食品并非全部有相同营养特征，例句应限定要比较的成分。

本题例句 · 编写示范

When added sugar is present in a large number of processed foods, clear labels can help parents compare products more easily.

适合儿童肥胖措施段中的食品信息环境；条件句聚焦添加糖与标签，避免把所有加工食品概括为有害。

回到这份材料的精读

健康观念变化：年份、十年与三大领域

the social and environmental conditions

社会与环境条件

适合说明健康行为受到可获得资源与生活环境的影响；必须接具体机制，不把抽象词组当成完整原因。

本题例句 · 编写示范

Measures to reduce childhood obesity should address the social and environmental conditions that make nutritious food and safe places to play difficult to access.

自编例句，直接对应儿童肥胖的原因与措施：把食物和活动空间的可达性作为可以改善的具体条件，不把所有责任归于儿童个人。

maintain healthy behaviours and lifestyles

维持有益健康的行为与生活方式

与提供条件和持续支持搭配；不承诺一项措施可以单独消除儿童肥胖。

本题例句 · 编写示范

Schools can help children maintain healthy behaviours and lifestyles by providing regular opportunities for physical activity and nutritious meals.

自编例句，用学校可采取的具体支持回应儿童肥胖题的措施部分；can表示可能贡献，不宣称所有儿童会因此获得相同结果。

回到这份材料的精读

A rise in childhood obesity is a real threat to health with an increasing number of children now classified as overweight. What are the causes of the problem and what measures can be taken to solve them?

完整写作 · 儿童肥胖：原因—措施对应而非空泛建议 →工作台尚未开始工作台保留一份独立首稿与修订；本页已有作答照常保留。

本次写作任务

写两个主体段，约180–220词：解释饮食环境与活动机会两个原因，再分别匹配学校/社区措施。这里练考试论证，不作个人医疗建议，也不写没有来源的研究数字。

参考写法

下列段落为针对原题编写的参考写法，用于对照内容和表达；写作没有唯一标准答案。

One contributing factor is that energy-dense convenience foods can be easier to obtain than balanced meals in children’s daily surroundings. Busy households may rely on ready-made options, and frequent promotion of snacks can make these products particularly appealing. At the same time, some children have limited opportunities to be physically active. Long periods spent sitting at school or using screens may be combined with a lack of safe places to play nearby. These circumstances can reinforce one another: an environment that encourages frequent snacking while making activity inconvenient creates persistent difficulties for healthy routines.

Responses should make healthier routines easier to maintain, rather than rely only on telling children to show more self-control. Schools can provide balanced meals and practical food education, while clear information for families can help them compare everyday choices. The lack of activity opportunities also needs a direct response. Safe routes to school, accessible play areas and regular opportunities for movement during the school day can reduce barriers to being active. Parents, schools and local authorities each influence part of this environment, so coordinated changes are more likely to be useful than an isolated awareness campaign that leaves the underlying conditions unchanged.

原因1食品获取/营销环境→学校均衡供餐和实用信息；原因2活动机会不足→安全路线、场地、在校活动。

不用“kids are lazy”作为单一原因；解释环境如何影响日常选择，避免道德评判。

参考段落是任务论证示范，未用虚构数字、未经核验研究或诊疗建议增加权威感。

答后精读

篇章结构

饮食与活动环境两个原因，最后交代相互强化。

按同样次序匹配措施，并解释为何宣传单独不够。

词语与搭配

contributing factor：因素之一，避免假装唯一原因。

reduce barriers to being active：措施如何起效。

underlying conditions：回指便利食品与活动机会环境。

句子精读

These circumstances can reinforce one another ... → 指代上文两类环境而非增加新原因。

... rather than rely only on telling children ... → 论证措施应改变条件，不只发口号。
